paragraphs.source_en: “The shogun’s wife and Lady Yodo are, after all, sisters by blood. No one could be better suited to convey my lord’s wishes to her.”

paragraphs.source_en: “When the shogun’s wife invites Lady Yodo to Edo, I shall call upon her and explain in detail our long-term plans for the Toyotomi clan. That was what I had originally intended. But for now, I shall first go to the capital in my lord’s name and say that my lord greatly wishes to see Hideyori. With me acting as intermediary, it should arouse no suspicion.”

paragraphs.source_zh: “在下会在将军夫人将淀夫人请到江户时去拜访，并将对丰臣氏的长久打算详细相告。这是在下先前的想法。不过，如今先以大人的名义去一趟京城，说大人很想见见秀赖。有在下斡旋，当不致引起什么猜测。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Understood. Tomorrow I shall first pay my respects to young Lord Gorōtamaru, then go directly to the shogun and report as well that I wish to serve as the young lord’s guardian and adviser.”

paragraphs.source_en: That day, the lord and his two retainers talked on until the Hour of the Boar.

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyori’s refusal to see Ieyasu sprang from a childish resentment: he had believed the rumors whispered around him.

units.source_en: Hideyori’s refusal to see Ieyasu sprang from a childish resentment: he had believed the rumors whispered around him.

paragraphs.source_en: Yet those around Ieyasu knew very well how painstakingly Lord Ieyasu had labored over the matter, and some were even angered by Hideyori’s conduct. If Ieyasu went all the way to the capital to see Hideyori without offering some explanation, those around him would naturally fail to understand and might grow resentful.

paragraphs.source_zh: 然而家康身边的人甚是清楚，家康公乃是如何苦心孤诣，有些人对此甚至心生恼怒。家康特意进京去见秀赖，若无个说法，自得不到众人的理解，以致生出怨怼。

paragraphs.source_en: All manner of thoughts circled through Ieyasu’s mind, and even as the Hour of the Ox approached, he still could not sleep. Masanari already had an idea, and Oeyo was more discerning still; perhaps he should hear what they had to say… Only after reaching the broad outlines of a decision did Ieyasu finally close his eyes in peace.
